items.definition: Bir hastalığın ya da sorunun ne olduğunu belirtilere ve muayeneye bakarak saptamak.
exampleSentences: Doctors diagnosed the condition as a rare form of anaemia.
The disease is often diagnosed too late for treatment to be effective.
It took specialists several months to diagnose the cause of her symptoms.

items.definition: Bir hastalığın varlığını gösteren, hastanın hissettiği ya da doktorun gözlemlediği belirti.
exampleSentences: A persistent cough was the first symptom she noticed.
Doctors ask patients to describe their symptoms in as much detail as possible.
The flu and the common cold share many of the same symptoms.

items.definition: Vücudun normal işleyişini bozan ve genellikle belirli belirtilerle kendini gösteren sağlık sorunu.
exampleSentences: Heart disease remains one of the leading causes of death worldwide.
The research team is trying to understand how the disease spreads between people.
Early screening can catch the disease before symptoms even appear.

items.definition: Bir hastalığı iyileştirmek veya kontrol altına almak için uygulanan tıbbi bakım ya da yöntem.
exampleSentences: The new treatment significantly reduced the patient's pain within a week.
Without proper treatment, the infection can spread to other organs.
Researchers are testing whether the treatment works better in combination with exercise.

items.definition: Tıbbi bakım veya tedavi gören kişi.
exampleSentences: The patient was discharged from hospital after a full recovery.
Nurses monitored the patient's vital signs throughout the night.
Each patient received a personalised treatment plan based on their test results.

items.definition: Bir hastalığı tedavi etmek veya bir yaralanmayı düzeltmek amacıyla vücut üzerinde yapılan tıbbi müdahale.
exampleSentences: She underwent surgery to repair the torn ligament in her knee.
Surgery is usually recommended only when other treatments have failed.
The surgeon explained the risks of the surgery before the operation began.

items.definition: Bakteri, virüs veya diğer mikroorganizmaların vücuda girip çoğalmasıyla ortaya çıkan hastalık durumu.
exampleSentences: The wound became infected because it was not cleaned properly.
A bacterial infection can often be treated with antibiotics.
Doctors traced the source of the infection to contaminated water.

items.definition: Bir hastalığı veya rahatsızlığı iyileştirmek ya da hafifletmek için uygulanan tedavi yöntemi.
exampleSentences: Physical therapy helped him regain movement in his injured shoulder.
She has been attending therapy twice a week since the accident.
The clinic offers speech therapy for children with developmental delays.

items.definition: Bir hastalık, yaralanma veya ameliyat sonrasında sağlığın yeniden kazanılması süreci.
exampleSentences: Her recovery from the operation took almost three months.
Doctors were pleased with how quickly the patient was recovering.
A balanced diet can speed up recovery after illness.

items.definition: Bir ilacın tek seferde alınması öngörülen miktarı.
exampleSentences: The doctor increased the dose after the first week showed no improvement.
Taking more than the recommended dose can be dangerous.
Each tablet contains a low dose of the active ingredient.

items.definition: Uzun süre devam eden veya sık sık tekrarlayan, kronik nitelikte olan (hastalık için).
exampleSentences: Chronic back pain forced her to change careers.
The disease is chronic, meaning it requires lifelong management rather than a one-time cure.
He was diagnosed with a chronic respiratory condition in his thirties.

items.definition: Aniden ortaya çıkan ve genellikle şiddetli fakat kısa süreli olan (hastalık veya durum için).
exampleSentences: The patient was admitted with acute abdominal pain.
An acute shortage of nurses put pressure on the emergency department.
Symptoms became acute within hours of the initial infection.

items.definition: Vücudu belirli bir hastalığa karşı bağışık kılmak amacıyla üretilen biyolojik madde.
exampleSentences: Scientists developed the vaccine in record time during the outbreak.
The vaccine is administered in two separate doses.
Health authorities urged the public to get vaccinated before winter.

items.definition: Vücudun hastalık yapan mikroorganizmalara karşı direnç gösterebilme özelliğine sahip olan.
exampleSentences: A healthy diet helps keep the immune system strong.
Once you have had the disease, you may become immune to it.
The vaccine works by training the immune system to recognise the virus.

items.definition: Vücudun büyümesi, gelişmesi ve sağlıklı kalması için gerekli besinlerin alınması ve kullanılması.
exampleSentences: Good nutrition during childhood supports healthy development later in life.
The clinic offers advice on nutrition for patients recovering from surgery.
Poor nutrition is linked to a higher risk of chronic disease.

items.definition: Vücutta sağlığı olumsuz etkileyecek ölçüde aşırı yağ birikmesiyle karakterize durum.
exampleSentences: Childhood obesity has risen sharply over the past two decades.
Obesity increases the risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
The programme aims to tackle obesity through diet and exercise.

items.definition: Bir hastalığın belirli bir bölgede kısa sürede çok sayıda insana yayılması durumu.
exampleSentences: The city declared an epidemic after cases tripled within a week.
An epidemic of measles swept through the region last spring.
Public health officials worked around the clock to contain the epidemic.

items.definition: Bir topluluk içinde belirli bir sürede meydana gelen ölüm oranı veya ölümlülük durumu.
exampleSentences: Infant mortality has fallen dramatically since the vaccine was introduced.
The study compared mortality rates across different age groups.
Improved sanitation played a major role in reducing mortality in the city.

items.definition: Bedenin veya zihnin normal işleyişinin bozulmasıyla ortaya çıkan sağlık sorunu.
exampleSentences: He was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder in his early twenties.
Sleep disorders can affect both physical and mental health.
The clinic specialises in treating eating disorders.

items.definition: İlaçların üretimi, geliştirilmesi veya satışıyla ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: The pharmaceutical company invested heavily in developing the new drug.
Pharmaceutical research has led to major advances in cancer treatment.
Strict regulations govern how pharmaceutical products are tested and sold.

items.definition: Hastaların doğrudan gözlemine veya tedavisine dayanan, hastane ya da klinik ortamında yürütülen.
exampleSentences: The drug passed clinical trials before it was approved for general use.
Clinical evidence suggests the treatment reduces recovery time.
She has ten years of clinical experience working in intensive care.

items.definition: Bir doktorun hastaya belirli bir ilaç veya tedavi önermesi ya da reçete yazması.
exampleSentences: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the throat infection.
Painkillers should only be prescribed when absolutely necessary.
Her physician prescribed a course of physiotherapy instead of surgery.

items.definition: Bağışıklık sisteminin normalde zararsız bir maddeye aşırı ve zararlı tepki vermesi durumu.
exampleSentences: His allergy to peanuts means he has to check every food label carefully.
Seasonal allergies get worse for many people in spring.
The doctor ran tests to identify the cause of her allergy.

items.definition: Canlıların özelliklerinin kalıtım yoluyla, genler aracılığıyla nesilden nesile aktarılmasıyla ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: Some forms of the disease have a strong genetic component.
Genetic testing can reveal whether a person carries the mutation.
Researchers are studying the genetic basis of the disorder.

items.definition: Hastalıkları önlemek amacıyla temizliğe ve sağlıklı alışkanlıklara dikkat edilmesi.
exampleSentences: Good hygiene practices can prevent the spread of many infections.
The hospital enforces strict hygiene standards in every ward.
Poor hygiene was identified as a major factor in the outbreak.

items.definition: Vücuda girdiğinde hastalığa yol açabilen bakteri, virüs veya başka bir mikroorganizma.
exampleSentences: The pathogen spreads easily through contaminated water.
Researchers identified a new pathogen responsible for the outbreak.
Hospitals use strict protocols to prevent pathogens from spreading between patients.

items.definition: Bakterilerin neden olduğu enfeksiyonları tedavi etmek için kullanılan ilaç.
exampleSentences: The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics for the infection.
Overusing antibiotics has contributed to the rise of resistant bacteria.
Not all infections respond to antibiotic treatment.

items.definition: Bir hastalık, yaralanma veya bağımlılık sonrasında kişinin işlevlerini yeniden kazanmasına yönelik tedavi süreci.
exampleSentences: He spent months in rehabilitation after the accident.
The rehabilitation programme includes both physical and psychological support.
Patients often need rehabilitation to regain full use of an injured limb.

items.definition: Hasarlı veya işlevini yitirmiş bir organın yerine sağlıklı bir organın nakledilmesi.
exampleSentences: She received a kidney transplant after years on dialysis.
Doctors performed the heart transplant in a twelve-hour operation.
The waiting list for organ transplants continues to grow.

items.definition: Bellek, düşünme ve akıl yürütme becerilerinin ilerleyici biçimde bozulmasıyla ortaya çıkan durum.
exampleSentences: Her grandmother was diagnosed with dementia in her late seventies.
Dementia gradually affects memory, communication and daily functioning.
The care home specialises in supporting patients with dementia.

items.definition: Doğrudan veya dolaylı temas yoluyla kolayca bir kişiden diğerine bulaşabilen (hastalık için).
exampleSentences: The virus is highly contagious and spreads quickly in crowded places.
Patients with contagious infections are isolated to protect others.
Health officials warned that the disease remains contagious for up to a week.

items.definition: Bir hastalığın, özellikle kanserin, belirtilerinin azalması veya tamamen kaybolduğu dönem.
exampleSentences: The cancer has been in remission for over two years.
Doctors were cautiously optimistic when the disease went into remission.
Some patients relapse even after long periods of remission.

items.definition: Kalp ve kan damarlarıyla ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: Regular exercise lowers the risk of cardiovascular disease.
The study examined the cardiovascular effects of long-term smoking.
A diet high in salt can harm cardiovascular health over time.

items.definition: Kişiyi sakinleştirmek veya uyutmak amacıyla verilen ilaç.
exampleSentences: The nurse administered a mild sedative before the procedure.
Sedatives are sometimes prescribed to help patients sleep before surgery.
Overuse of sedatives can lead to dependence.

items.definition: Gerçek bir etkin madde içermeyen, ancak tedavi etkisini test etmek için kullanılan madde.
exampleSentences: Half the participants received the drug, and half received a placebo.
Some patients reported improvement even after taking the placebo.
The placebo effect can influence how a patient perceives pain.

items.definition: Düşünme, öğrenme, hatırlama ve akıl yürütme gibi zihinsel süreçlerle ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: The illness gradually affected her cognitive abilities.
Researchers measured cognitive function before and after the treatment.
Ageing is often accompanied by a slow cognitive decline.

items.definition: Bir hastalığın muhtemel seyri ve sonucu hakkında yapılan tıbbi tahmin.
exampleSentences: The prognosis was encouraging, with a high chance of full recovery.
Doctors gave the family an honest assessment of the prognosis.
Early diagnosis generally improves the prognosis for this condition.

items.definition: Bir hastalığın veya durumun belirli bir nüfus içinde ne kadar yaygın olduğu.
exampleSentences: The prevalence of obesity has increased steadily over the past decade.
Researchers measured the prevalence of the disease across different regions.
High prevalence of the infection prompted a nationwide screening programme.

items.definition: Halk sağlığını korumak amacıyla temiz su temini ve atıkların uygun şekilde bertaraf edilmesi.
exampleSentences: Poor sanitation contributes to the spread of waterborne diseases.
The programme aims to improve sanitation in rural communities.
Investment in sanitation has significantly reduced infection rates in the city.
items.translationTR: sağlık koşulları, atık ve su yönetimi (sanitasyon)

items.definition: Kalple ilgili veya kalbi etkileyen.
exampleSentences: He was rushed to hospital after suffering a cardiac arrest.
The unit specialises in treating patients with cardiac conditions.
Cardiac surgery has advanced significantly over the past twenty years.

items.definition: Vücudun belirli bir hastalığa karşı direnç gösterebilme yeteneği.
exampleSentences: The vaccine provides long-lasting immunity against the virus.
Natural immunity can develop after recovering from an infection.
Scientists are studying how quickly immunity fades over time.

items.definition: Bir organizmanın genetik yapısında meydana gelen kalıcı değişiklik.
exampleSentences: A single genetic mutation was found to cause the disorder.
The virus had mutated into a more resistant strain.
Researchers track mutations to understand how diseases evolve.

items.definition: Kontrolsüz biçimde büyüyerek vücudun diğer bölgelerine yayılabilen, kötü huylu (tümör için).
exampleSentences: The biopsy confirmed that the tumour was malignant.
Malignant cells can spread rapidly to nearby tissue.
Doctors removed the malignant growth before it could spread further.

items.definition: Zararsız, vücudun diğer bölgelerine yayılmayan (tümör için); iyi huylu.
exampleSentences: Fortunately, the lump turned out to be benign.
Most skin growths of this kind are benign and require no treatment.
The scan confirmed a benign tumour with no sign of spreading.

items.definition: Ölüm nedenini belirlemek amacıyla bir cesedin tıbbi olarak incelenmesi.
exampleSentences: The autopsy revealed that the victim had died of natural causes.
An autopsy was ordered to determine the exact cause of death.
Pathologists perform autopsies to answer questions a death certificate cannot.

items.definition: Bir hastalığı iyileştirmek yerine acıyı ve belirtileri hafifletmeye yönelik (bakım için).
exampleSentences: The hospice provides palliative care for terminally ill patients.
Palliative treatment focuses on comfort rather than a cure.
She chose palliative care in the final stage of her illness.

items.definition: Ebeveynlerden çocuklara genetik yolla aktarılan (hastalık veya özellik için).
exampleSentences: The condition is hereditary and tends to run in families.
Doctors asked about any hereditary illnesses in her family history.
Not all forms of the disease are hereditary.

items.definition: Bir etkene, tedaviye veya değişime karşı direnç gösterme veya karşı koyma durumu.
exampleSentences: Overuse of antibiotics has led to growing resistance among bacteria.
The body's resistance to infection weakens with age.
Scientists are searching for ways to overcome drug resistance.

items.definition: Bir hastalığa, enfeksiyona veya etkiye karşı kolayca etkilenebilir, savunmasız olan.
exampleSentences: Young children are particularly susceptible to this type of infection.
People with weakened immune systems are more susceptible to disease.
The elderly tend to be more susceptible to complications from flu.

items.definition: Uzun süre yaşama veya var olma durumu, uzun ömürlülük.
exampleSentences: A healthy diet and regular exercise are linked to greater longevity.
Researchers study certain populations to understand the secrets of longevity.
Improvements in medicine have contributed to increased human longevity.

items.definition: Zararlı sonuçlar doğuran, olumsuz etkisi olan.
exampleSentences: Smoking has a detrimental effect on cardiovascular health.
Prolonged stress can be detrimental to both physical and mental wellbeing.
The report warned that the delay would be detrimental to patient care.

items.definition: Bir durumu, özellikle kötü veya rahatsız edici bir durumu, daha iyi hale getirmek.
exampleSentences: The new drug was designed to ameliorate the symptoms of the disease.
Better housing conditions helped ameliorate the health of the community.
Doctors hoped the treatment would ameliorate her chronic pain.

items.definition: Bir sorunu, hastalığı veya durumu daha da kötüleştirmek, şiddetlendirmek.
exampleSentences: Stress can exacerbate symptoms of an existing heart condition.
Skipping medication may exacerbate the disease's progression.
Poor air quality tends to exacerbate respiratory problems.

items.definition: Kişiyi güçsüz bırakan, günlük işlevleri ciddi biçimde zayıflatan (hastalık veya durum için).
exampleSentences: The disease left him with a debilitating weakness in his legs.
Chronic migraines can be debilitating enough to prevent people from working.
She continued to work despite her debilitating illness.

items.definition: Bir acıyı, sorunu veya rahatsızlığı hafifletmek, azaltmak.
exampleSentences: The medication helped alleviate her chronic back pain.
Simple breathing exercises can alleviate anxiety before surgery.
Doctors prescribed painkillers to alleviate the discomfort.

items.definition: Bir topluluk içinde belirli bir hastalığın görülme sıklığı veya hastalık hali.
exampleSentences: The study measured both morbidity and mortality associated with the disease.
Rates of morbidity from the infection were higher in older adults.
Improved sanitation has reduced morbidity linked to waterborne illnesses.

items.definition: Hastalıkların bir toplumda nasıl yayıldığını ve nedenlerini inceleyen bilim dalı.
exampleSentences: She specialises in the epidemiology of infectious diseases.
Epidemiology helped researchers trace the outbreak back to its source.
The university offers a graduate programme in epidemiology.

items.definition: Hastalıkların nedenlerini, gelişimini ve etkilerini inceleyen tıp dalı; ayrıca bir hastalığın kendisi.
exampleSentences: The lab report confirmed the pathology of the tumour.
He works as a specialist in pathology at the city hospital.
Understanding the underlying pathology is essential for effective treatment.

items.definition: Hızla yayılan ve ciddi zarar veren, çok şiddetli etkiye sahip (hastalık etkeni için).
exampleSentences: A more virulent strain of the virus emerged the following winter.
The infection proved highly virulent, spreading rapidly through the ward.
Researchers are studying why this strain is so virulent.

items.definition: Bir sorunu yalnızca bir parçasıyla değil, bütünüyle ele alan (özellikle sağlıkta beden ve zihni birlikte değerlendiren).
exampleSentences: The clinic takes a holistic approach to treating chronic illness.
Holistic care considers a patient's emotional and social wellbeing, not just their symptoms.
She switched to a more holistic method of managing her condition.
